thesis: ASO is in a strong, orderly uptrend (above SMA20/50/200, +47% over 63 days) and is digesting its Nov 9 high on light volume, which is a constructive pullback. It is cheap in absolute terms (forward P/E 9.6) and profitable with low dilution risk. About 20% short interest adds squeeze fuel if it retests the high. The case is only moderate, though. The regime is risk-off, growth is decelerating, price is above the mean analyst target, and earnings on 2026-12-08 are a binary event. This favors a small, disciplined entry inside the zone with the defined stop, not chasing.
